comments.label: playbackDock
comments.text:
The hover effect on these chapter toggles don't match E-002. 

Also, after the first chapter, you should advance to the next chapter (via the moving forward in time sequence).

comments.label: pairSticky
comments.text: This sticky header should always go: "[chaser (in gold)] + [target (in gray)]". So in this case, you should put the USA 270 satellite first, then the Chinese ones via their dropdown.

comments.label: 3D globe
comments.text: On page load, you should be centering the gray satellite (because it's the target) on relative motion view.

comments.label: zoomOutBtn
comments.text: Is it just me, or is the minus sign here not quite centered. On all full viz, they these symbols should be centered.

comments.label: identity
comments.text: The chevron on these two satellite details dropdowns aren't lining up; and they should.

comments.label: thresholdControls
comments.text: When you're showing very low km/s values on the y-axis, you should be doing m/s.

comments.label: thresholdControls
comments.text: Try 10 m/s as as default relative velocity threshold for this episode.
